key_insight: OptScientist discovers compact symbolic optimization laws that explain observed behavior as the outcome of an underlying optimization problem.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help engineers infer interpretable objectives and constraints from observations rather than fit input–output equations alone.
method: Learn an optimization-based representation of data, then extract its symbolic form.
Use an LLM agent to incorporate literature-based priors and discover candidate laws.
Abstract candidate mechanisms and suggest new data to collect.
evidence_signal: On the 99-problem OptFeynman benchmark, OptScientist recovers over 80% of ground-truth laws; on risky choice and monetary policy, it achieves competitive held-out prediction with few parameters and fewer tokens than LLM baselines.
watch_item: Predictive accuracy alone does not establish that a discovered objective or constraint is the true mechanism generating the observations.
paper_title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws
